name: Hegnar Rumbleshot
summary: On the snowy road from Coldridge Pass to Kharanos, Hegnar Rumbleshot keeps a gunsmith's camp. He supplies local hunters and mountaineers with firearms and ammunition.

sections.title: A Gunsmith on the Road
sections.body: Hegnar Rumbleshot keeps a small camp between Coldridge Pass and Kharanos, where he serves dwarven marksmen, travelers, and the local militia. At the camp, mountain folk use a popular range to hone their aim against the wild beasts prowling Dun Morogh. The steady stream of shooters leaves Hegnar in need of fresh ammunition from his supplier, the dwarf engineer Loslor Rudge.

faq.answer: Hegnar Rumbleshot keeps a gunsmith's camp and outdoor shooting range along the road between Coldridge Pass and Kharanos.

faq.q: Where does Hegnar get his ammunition?
faq.answer: Hegnar gets ammunition from Loslor Rudge, a dwarf engineer elsewhere in Dun Morogh who supplies the range.

faq.q: What does Hegnar do for the local dwarves?
faq.answer: Hegnar outfits local hunters and militia members with firearms and shot, and offers a practice range for marksmen traveling through Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a hunter heading from Coldridge Valley into Dun Morogh's snowy peaks, you can get shot, ammunition pouches, and spare firearms from Hegnar.
As a dwarf, you can join travelers at Hegnar's roadside range to practice your marksmanship.
